claims.statement: CPVC capex completed with volumes expected to improve from Q4FY24
SIOP line balancing capex nearing completion
Solar investment completed, power cost benefits expected from H2
Management declined to give revenue guidance for FY25 due to volatile pricing but outlined volume growth drivers in Specialty segment
SIOP production capacity to increase from 18,000 to 27,000-28,000 tons per annum after debottlenecking; target sales of 25,000-26,000 tons in FY25
CPVC capacity doubled to 20,000 tons per annum; running at full production of ~1,800 tons per month
Synthetic Rutile capacity 40,000 tons per annum post debottlenecking; running at 90% utilization
Soda Ash plant technical issues to be resolved by Q4 FY25; targeting 85% utilization this fiscal year
SIOP margins steady around 35%, may improve slightly with economies of scale from additional production
CPVC margins around 30% at current prices
Soda Ash margins 18-20% normally; expect north of 20% once plant operates at 100%
Caustic Soda currently operated not-for-profit due to subdued chlorine prices; used to derive inputs for Synthetic Rutile and CPVC
PVC standard margin 3-5%; profit/loss driven by inventory carry effect on price movements
Routine capex Rs 35-40 crore per annum; efficiency capex Rs 15-20 crore; growth capex to be announced and funded via bank borrowings
Major growth project payments of Rs 125 crore for CPVC and SIOP completed in FY24; Rs 20 crore invested in captive solar
SIOP capacity enhanced from 18,000 TPA to 30,000 TPA, capitalised Q1-FY25
CPVC Phase II capacity doubled from 10,800 TPA to 21,600 TPA, capitalised Q3-FY24
44.5 MW group captive renewable power project expected completion H2-FY25
58 MW captive power capacity
~2,500 acres of land available at Sahupuram facility
Consolidated EBITDA margin 10% vs 13% YoY; specialty EBITDA doubled to Rs 47.8 cr at 36% margin; commodity EBITDA fell to Rs 3.5 cr from Rs 31 cr YoY
CPVC capacity doubled, running at 100% in Q1; SIOP line balancing completed in May, production up 15% vs last fiscal average; renewable energy project on track for H2 completion
CPVC margins to remain in mid-30% range; anti-dumping duty not for profiteering but to protect domestic industry and encourage investment
Management refrains from giving revenue or margin guidance due to immense uncertainty in global geopolitical environment; performance skewed to H2 like last year
Additional CPVC investment of Rs 150 cr for 20,000 MT on drawing board; timeline depends on financial position, capital requirement and turnaround time
Soda ash operating at 75-80% capacity since Q2 FY24; Q1 had small stoppages and kiln revamp; expected 80-85% for rest of year
Q2 FY25 profitability under more pressure; PVC price corrections to reduce profits; specialty (SIOP, CPVC) to improve slightly; soda ash to improve
Expects H2 FY25 to be better overall with stability in synthetic rutile exports from Q4 and improvement in caustic soda pricing in Q3
Expects 20-25% more SIOP volumes in H2 vs H1 with stable margins
Announced INR140 crore capex to add 30,000 tons C-PVC capacity; 20,000 tons by end Q2 FY26, 10,000 tons by end FY26
Renewable energy project expected to be operational by Q4 FY25
C-PVC capacity currently 20,000 tons at 100% utilization; expanding to 50,000 tons
Q2 FY25 utilization: soda ash 88%, caustic soda 78%, PVC ~100%, SIOP 88%, C-PVC 100%
Specialty segment EBITDA INR48 crore in Q2, up 50% YoY; commodity segment EBITDA loss INR12 crore, PVC loss INR13.5 crore
Q2 FY25 consolidated EBITDA INR35 crore, down 15% YoY; margin 7.2%; net loss INR1.2 crore
H1 FY25 EBITDA INR81 crore, down 13% YoY; margin 8.2%; net profit INR5.5 crore, down 57% YoY
Incremental volume tie-up with export customers for SIOP in process; expects H2 sales improvement
CPVC Phase III capacity enhancement from 21,600 TPA to 50,000 TPA, expected completion Sep 25 and Mar 26
Investment in 44.5 MW group captive renewable power project at Sahupuram, expected completion H2 FY25
Specialty chemicals volume growth in SIOP and CPVC on YoY basis for quarter and 9M FY25
Commodity segment volumes flat with negative bias in PVC and Caustic
Soda ash EBITDA target 18-20% at current prices after machinery installation
Legacy term debt to be repaid in 2-2.5 years; new CPVC capex debt has 5-year tenure
CPVC Phase-3 first phase (20K to 40K TPA) volumes to be placed gradually from Q3 FY26
Renewable power project expected annual savings Rs 35-40 crore at current blended power prices
Synthetic rutile business to be much better in FY26 with orders booked to current production capacity at better prices
Alternative energy project Phase 1 operational by end of January, Phase 2 by end of March
CPVC expansion Phase 1 (20K to 40K TPA) construction underway, commissioning targeted by September 2025
SIOP debottlenecking capex approximately Rs 30-35 crore within the Rs 125 crore previous capex
Overall capacity utilization above 80% across all product categories in Q3; PVC and CPVC at full capacity
Soda ash operating at 80-85% capacity for last 9 months; full 100% production expected from end of Q1 FY26
Commodity segment EBITDA turned positive Rs 14.2 crore vs loss of Rs 6 crore QoQ driven by caustic price increase 11% and better VCM-PVC spread
Synthetic rutile historic margins north of 20%; recovery gradual with long-term contracts secured
SIOP and CPVC EBITDA margin target 30-35% but difficult to guarantee given geopolitics
Specialty chemicals achieved highest ever sales in first 9 months of FY25; 42% EBITDA growth YoY
Synthetic rutile export sales 8 KT in Q3; orders booked to current production capacity for FY26
C-PVC Phase III expansion from 21,600 TPA to 50,000 TPA; 20 KT by Sep-25, balance by Mar-26
44.5 MW group captive renewable power project to substitute 25% power at Sahupuram, completion H2-FY25
C-PVC installed capacity 21,600 MTPA
SIOP capacity enhanced from 18,000 TPA to 30,000 TPA
Soda Ash installed capacity 108,000 MTPA
PVC installed capacity 100,000 MTPA
Caustic Soda installed capacity 96,000 MTPA
C-PVC Phase III expansion to 50 KT and SIOP debottlenecking to full 28 KT capacity underway
CPVC Phase III expansion from 21,600 TPA to 50,000 TPA expected ahead of schedule
Renewable power project 44.5 MW group captive commissioned 3rd April 2025 to substitute 25% power at Sahupuram
FY27 EBITDA target of INR 400 crores reiterated based on C-PVC ramp-up, power project benefits, Soda Ash debottlenecking and SIOP efficiency gains
C-PVC expansion of 30,000 tons at Sahupuram ahead of schedule; first 20,000 tons expected before September 2025, remaining 10,000 tons by March 2026
Soda Ash plant operated at 80% capacity (80,000 tons) in FY25 due to compressor issues; compressor arrived from Germany, targeting 95,000 tons production in FY26
FY25 consolidated EBITDA margin 11% vs 10.5% in FY24; Specialty EBITDA margin ~35%, Basic Chemicals EBITDA dropped 59% to INR 19 crores

CPVC Phase III 20 KT capacity addition completed ahead of schedule by Sep 2025
Solar park 44.5 MW group captive commissioned 3rd April 2025 to substitute 25% power at Sahupuram
Finance cost expected to decline further in coming quarters
Target net debt-to-EBITDA below 0.5x by end of FY26
No revenue or EBITDA guidance given for FY26 or FY27 due to price volatility
C-PVC expansion of 20,000 tons commissioned ahead of schedule, balance 10,000 tons progressing as planned
44.5 MW solar project commissioned in Q1, generation ramping up in phases
Annual capex run-rate around INR150 crores; new proposals under evaluation but going slow due to geopolitical uncertainties
C-PVC capacity to reach 50,000 tons by end of FY26
Solar project to meet ~25% of Tamil Nadu units' power requirements when fully operational
EBITDA margin (excl. other income) at 11.3% in Q1 FY26 vs 9% in Q1 FY25 and 10.4% in Q4 FY25

Target net debt to EBITDA below 0.5x by end of FY26, expecting as low as 0.4x

Aspire to reach Rs. 2,500 crore annualized revenue at current prices with additional 10 KT CPVC capacity

Multiple specialty chemical opportunities in feasibility and board review, expect to convert to committed investments over next few quarters

Synthetic rutile plated capacity 48 KT, historically producing around 40 KT

CPVC spread maintained at ~30% over PVC, but absolute profits down due to price erosion

Specialty Chemical volumes increase doubling CPVC capacity from 20KT to 40KT and SIOP from 18KT to 30KT

C-PVC capacity expanded by 30,000 tons to 50,000 tons total, commissioned on time and within budget, with final 10,000 tons completed end of March
SIOP capacity at 28,000 tons after debottlenecking, currently operating near full utilization with no further volume growth scope
Record sales volumes achieved in C-PVC, synthetic iron oxide pigment and synthetic rutile in FY26

SIOP Phase I capex of 7,000 MT planned for capitalisation in Q4-FY28
